children: Shares of Limbach Holdings jumped after the company's third-quarter profit and revenue came in ahead of analyst expectations.
Shares were up 19% to $59.54 in after-hours trading. The stock closed up 6.4% at $49.92, having lost 36% this year.
The building systems solutions company on Tuesday reported a profit of $9.5 million, or 79 cents a share, compared with a profit of $8.8 million, or 73 cents a share, a year earlier.
Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were $1.37 a share. Analysts polled by FactSet were expecting $1.21 a share.
Revenue rose to $230.5 million from $184.6 million a year prior. Analysts were expecting $218.6 million in revenue.

"Our third-quarter results reflect improving customer activity and a return to organic growth in our owner-direct business," Chief Executive Michael McCann said. "We believe some of the project timing issues we discussed earlier this year are beginning to ease, giving us a clearer view of the work ahead."

The company reaffirmed its full-year guidance for revenue and adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, but said it is currently tracking toward the high end of those ranges.
